FAQs

Flooring Questions, Answered

What people ask before they ring, answered by Sean and the team in their own words.

Quotes and Prices The Floors We Fit The Work About Us

Quotes and Prices

Do you offer free flooring quotations?

Yes. We provide free, no-obligation quotations and help customers choose the most suitable flooring for their property and budget. Call or WhatsApp 07748 146181, or use the quote form.

How much does new flooring cost in Aberdeen?

Prices depend on the flooring material, room size and preparation required. We provide free quotations following an assessment of your project. As a guide, supply and installation typically starts from £45 to £75 per m² for laminate, £65 to £95 per m² for LVT, £85 to £125 per m² for engineered wood and £110 to £155 per m² for herringbone.

How long does flooring installation take?

Most installations take between 1 and 5 days, depending on the flooring type, room size and preparation required. Laminate is usually 1 to 2 days, LVT and engineered wood 1 to 3 days, and herringbone 3 to 6 days, depending on the size and complexity of the project.

The Floors We Fit

What types of flooring do you install?

We specialise in engineered wood, luxury vinyl tile (LVT), laminate, herringbone, chevron and bespoke parquet flooring. See all our flooring services.

Is engineered wood flooring better than laminate?

Engineered wood features a real hardwood surface and offers a more natural premium appearance. Laminate is generally a more affordable and low-maintenance alternative. More on engineered wood flooring and laminate flooring.

What is the difference between LVT and laminate flooring?

LVT is manufactured from luxury vinyl materials and is generally more resistant to moisture. Laminate has a fibreboard core with a decorative surface and is a popular cost-effective alternative. More on LVT flooring.

Is herringbone flooring suitable for my home?

Absolutely. Herringbone flooring works beautifully in hallways, living rooms, kitchens and open-plan spaces, adding character and elegance to your property. See the herringbone floors we have fitted.

Can you install herringbone flooring in a hallway?

Yes. Herringbone flooring is particularly popular in hallways and entrance areas, creating an attractive first impression. Stairs, hallways and landings.

Can you install flooring over underfloor heating?

Many engineered wood and LVT products are suitable for underfloor heating, provided the manufacturer's installation requirements and temperature restrictions are followed.

Do you supply premium flooring brands?

We can source quality flooring from established manufacturers and help you select the right product, finish and specification for your project. Tell us what you have in mind.

The Work

Do you prepare and level subfloors?

Yes. We assess the existing subfloor and can carry out suitable preparation, repairs and levelling before installing your new flooring. Floor preparation and levelling.

Do you remove existing flooring?

Yes. We can arrange the removal and disposal of existing flooring as part of your complete installation package. How we prepare the floor.

Do you install flooring in commercial properties?

Yes. We can provide flooring solutions for suitable commercial premises, offices, rental properties and refurbishment projects. See our work.
